_comment: S2 half-<111> study.  330 C is the primary reconciliation target: it is the
richest self-consistent cluster in InterstitialLoop.xlsx (BOR-60, 15 dpa,
three paired rows at f_100 = 72-73%) and its 6-7 nm loops are the only ones
in the high-f_100 regime that are reachable at affordable dose.  The 350 C
HFR point (d_100 = 48 nm) is out of reach on any grid we can run.
G accelerated to 1e-6 as in S1, same reason and same caveat.

S330.label: 330 C, G=1e-6 (proxy for BOR-60 330 C / 15 dpa)

admissibility_rule.note: delta_FP is blind to SIA-axis truncation (the <100> pile-up held delta_FP at 1e-8 while 96% of content sat at n=I), so grid adequacy is judged by pile/occupancy. It is NOT blind to the VACANCY axis -- delta_FP rests on the swelling identity S = S_I + Delta J^d and S is the vacancy inventory. The vacancy axis was unchecked until 2026-08-02; at the check_machine probe (V=120) mean_n_v moved 18.7->136 and swelling 58x on going to V=240.
